senses.gloss: रम् vi. 1Ā (pp. रत; pres. रमते; desid. रिरंसते) 1. To rest, to remain quiet, to stay, to use; 2. to be pleased or lighted, to rejoice at, लोलापांगैर्यदि न रमसे लौचनैर्वचितोसि Megh.i.27; 3. to play, to sport with, मत्तो मांतर्धियाः सीते मा रस्था जीवितेन नः Bt.vi.15; 4. to have sexual intercourse with, स्वच्छंदं बहुवल्लभः स रमते Git.G.vii.With अभि-, to rejoice, to be delighted, Bg.xviii.45.With आ-, 1. to cease, to rest, M.ii.73; 2. to take pleasure in, Bt.viii.52.With उप-, 1. to cease, to stop, to end, यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया Bg.vi.20; 2. to desist from, उपारंसीच्च संपश्यन्वानरस्तं चिकीर्षितात् Bt.viii.54; 3. to die.With परि-, (Par.) to be delighted, Bt.viii.53.With वि-, 1. to cease, to end, अविदित गतयामा रात्रिरेव व्यरंसीत् Ut.i.; 2. to desist, to stop, ज्वरज्वाला शांता तदपि न वराकी विरमति Bhartr.iii.67; (often with an abl., वत्सैतस्माद्विरम विरमातः परं न क्षमोस्मि Ut.i.).With सम्-, to rejoice, Bt.xix.30.
रम् Caus. (रमयति-ते) to please, to delight, to amuse.
रम m. 1. Joy; 2. a lover, husband; 3. the god of love.
रमा f. 1. A wife, a mistress; 2. an epithet of Lakṣmī, the wife of Viṣṇu and the goddess of wealth.
राम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Delighting, rejoicing; 2. beautiful, charming; 3. obscure, dark-coloured, black; 4. white.
राम (II) m. 1. Name of several ancient heroes, especially of Paraśurāma, Balarāma and Rāmachandra, the son of Daśaratha; (See App. II.); 2. a species of deer.
राम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Delighting, rejoicing; 2. beautiful, charming; 3. obscure, dark-coloured, black; 4. white.
रामा f. 1. A beautiful woman, a young and charming woman; 2. a woman in general, रामा हरंति हृदयं प्रसभं नराणाम् Rt.vi.25; 3. a woman of low origin; 4. vermilion.
रमठ n. Asa Fœtida.
रामठ m.n. Asa Fœtida.
रमठ-ध्वनि m. the same as रमठ q.v.
रमण (I) a. (f. णी) Pleasing, delightful, charming, Bt.vi.77.
रमण (II) m. 1. A lover, a husband, प्रायेणैते रमणविरहेष्वंगनानां विनोदाः Megh.ii.24, R.xiv.27; 2. the god of love; 3. an ass; 4. a testicle.
रमण (III) n. 1. Sporting; 2. dalliance, amorous sport; 3. coition; 4. pleasure in general; 5. the hip and the loins.
रमणा f. 1. A charming woman; 2. a wife, a mistress, रतिश्रांता शेते रजनिरमणी गाढमुरसि K.Pr.x.
रमण (I) a. (f. णी) Pleasing, delightful, charming, Bt.vi.77.
रमणा f. 1. A charming woman; 2. a wife, a mistress, रतिश्रांता शेते रजनिरमणी गाढमुरसि K.Pr.x.
रमणीय a. (f. या) Pleasant, delightful, handsome, charming, प्रियायाः साबाधं तदपि रमणीयं वपुरिदम् Sak.iii.
रमणीय a. (f. या) Pleasant, delightful, handsome, charming, प्रियायाः साबाधं तदपि रमणीयं वपुरिदम् Sak.iii.
रमा-कान्त, -नाथ, -पति m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
रमा-कान्त, -नाथ, -पति m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
रमा-कान्त, -नाथ, -पति m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
रमा-वेष्ट m. turpentine.

रम्भा f. 1. A plantain tree, गतिर्जनमनोरमा विजितरम्भमूरुद्वयम् Git.G.x.; 2. a name of Gaurī; 3. name of an Apsaras, the wife of Nalakūbara, and the most beautiful nymph of Indra’s paradise, रम्भा स्नुषा धनपतेरिव सा तवापि B.R.ii.
रम्भा-ऊरु a. (f. रु or रू) having thighs as full and round as a plantain tree.
रम्भा-ऊरु a. (f. रु or रू) having thighs as full and round as a plantain tree.
रम्य (I) a. (f. म्या) 1. Pleasant, delightful, सुखाः प्रदोषा दिवसाश्च रम्याः Rt.vi.2; 2. beautiful, handsome, सरसिजमनुविद्धं शैवलेनापि रम्यम् Sak.i.
रम्य (II) m. The champaka tree.
रम्य (III) n. Semen virile.
रम्य (I) a. (f. म्या) 1. Pleasant, delightful, सुखाः प्रदोषा दिवसाश्च रम्याः Rt.vi.2; 2. beautiful, handsome, सरसिजमनुविद्धं शैवलेनापि रम्यम् Sak.i.
राम-अनुज m. name of the founder of a Vedāntic sect; he has written a Bhāshya on the Vedānta sūtra.
राम-गिरि m. name of a mountain, स्निग्धच्छायातरुषु वसतिं रामगिर्याश्रमेषु Megh.i.1.
राम-चंद्र, -भद्र m. name of Rāma, son of Daśaratha.
राम-चंद्र, -भद्र m. name of Rāma, son of Daśaratha.
राम-नवमी f. the ninth day in the light half of Chaitra, the anniversary of the birth of Rāmachandra.
राम-सेतु m. a bridge of sand, now a chain of islands, between the Indian peninsula and Ceylon (called ‘Adam’s bridge’ by the Europeans).
रामणीयक (I) a. (f. की) Beautiful, pleasing.
रामणीयक (II) n. Loveliness, charmingness, beauty, सा रामणीयकनिधेरधिदेवता M.M.i.
रामणीयक (I) a. (f. की) Beautiful, pleasing.
